some porcelanite boulders are included with the Wibaux soils. The Thedalund loam is on the highest hill tops. The Spearman and Wibaux soils in this complex have profiles similar to those described in their respective series.
The surface runoff is rapid, and the erosion hazard is severe.
This complex is suited to range.
(Capability Unit IVe-3 Dryland; Silty range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 3M)
